Hints: Multiply right to left. Add each carried value once, then regroup complete groups of ten.
Solution: Work right to left. ones: 7 x 5 = 35; write 5, carry 3. tens: 1 x 5 + carried 3 = 8; write 8. Thus 17 x 5 = 85.
